**Aura 1.2.3 — Spring Physics Action Button HUD**

* Apple-style Action Button with spring physics (damping: 0.7)
* Dark glass blur (UIBlurEffectStyleDark) with 2x2 shortcut grid
* Direct app launch via SBUIController without openURL delays
* Zero dyld load-time execution (no bootloops or Watchdog panics)
* Strict Pure GNU Tar format (resolves corrupted filesystem tarfile error)

**Compatibility:** iPhone 5s (Apple A7 arm64), iOS 12.0 – 12.5.8.
**Architecture:** Rootful Sileo / Zebra / Cydia APT.
